hook_line: 13 LAWMAKERS SEEK FEDERAL PROBE INTO SEATTLE DIWALI EVENT DISRUPTION

hook_stat.sub: US lawmakers asking the Justice Department to investigate the Seattle Diwali disruption

stats.label: Indian American House members among the signatories

diaspora_bullets: The Diwali festival at the Seattle Center Armory was disrupted on November 7
The lawmakers asked for a Justice Department briefing by December 4
news_summary: Thirteen US lawmakers, including all six Indian American House members, have asked the Justice Department to investigate whether the November 7 disruption of a Diwali festival in Seattle violated federal civil rights laws.
payoff: The Justice Department has not publicly responded, and the lawmakers have asked for a briefing by December 4.
